basics.name: Yu (Terry) Deng
basics.label: PhD Student in Management Science and Engineering
basics.summary: I am a PhD student at Xi'an Jiaotong University, with a research focus on machine learning. My interests connect information systems, cybersecurity and AI security. My professional experience includes enterprise AI assistants, security operations, IT infrastructure and user support.

researchInterests: AI and large language model security
Organizational technology adoption and user behavior

details: Study areas include machine learning and decision analysis, advanced game theory, and optimization.
Thesis: Feasibility of Deploying Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in Enterprises.
Study areas include information systems security and risk management, business research methods, AI in business, systems analysis, and database management.
Graduation project: Qitu (器途), a prototype for a tool application.
Study areas include UI/UX prototyping, information visualization, user experience and interaction design, social research, and Python programming.

highlights: Developed AI agents and Dify workflows for alert triage and security analysis in an AI-powered SIEM platform.
Built SIEM dashboards and log pipelines with Splunk, ELK and OpenSearch.
Maintained incident-response procedures, runbooks and ticketing workflows in Jira and ManageEngine, with knowledge bases in Confluence and Feishu Wiki.
Supported security exercises, vulnerability management and remediation reporting.

work.position: Engineering Internship — IT and Information Security
highlights: Built and deployed an internal knowledge assistant using full-parameter LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Dify workflows.
Developed a domain-enrollment tool and supported Microsoft Active Directory and Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints.
Deployed infrastructure and Zabbix monitoring, resolved technical issues, and documented information-security policies.
Delivered employee training and supported security-awareness activities.
Assessed security practices against ISO 27001, benchmarked peer organizations and prepared compliance checklists.
Contributed a security assessment report with recommendations for access control and permissions.
Identified customer needs and explained suitable products and solutions.
Supported device troubleshooting, system recovery, data migration and personalized setup.
